# hostops

> Allowlisted, audited server operations for self-managed Linux web hosts, plus a Claude Code plugin that uses it. Methodology: observe → plan → dry-run → confirm → execute → verify-served → log.

Every command is typed; there is no generic run command. Write commands exit 4 unless given `--confirm=<token>` printed by `--dry-run`. Output is JSON when stdout is not a TTY; every document carries a `schema` field.

## Docs
- [README](https://github.com/jlugo32/hostops/blob/main/README.md): install, commands, exit codes, skills
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/jlugo32/hostops/blob/main/CLAUDE.md): rules for agents working on or with hostops
- [Methodology](https://github.com/jlugo32/hostops/blob/main/docs/methodology.md)
- [Threat model](https://github.com/jlugo32/hostops/blob/main/docs/threat-model.md)
- [JSON schemas](https://github.com/jlugo32/hostops/tree/main/docs/schema)
- [ADRs](https://github.com/jlugo32/hostops/tree/main/adr)

## Exit codes
0 ok, 1 general, 2 permission, 3 validation, 4 confirmation required, 5 verification failed, 6 partial/inconclusive
